## Findings refused

- Unit 0 note quoting 動了有 (not at word 7): refused; the note names the frame of units 0–3 and 動了有 occurs in 1–3.
- Unit 16 note 被傷着 joining two packet words (被傷 + 着): refused; it is a faithful join across the split word.
- Unit 31 `že` absent from `i` (l has 'indeed'): refused; published 105–108 also drops že, glossary says 'indeed, so'.
- Unit 40 note's `吐` (not in unit): refused; it cites earlier units, as the sentence says.
- Units 4 and 9 readings (own qā; 'edeġed hüleġüd'): not changed beyond flags; the drafter already says they rest on the Ming.
- 'Chinggis' etc. spellings, 'Wang Qan', 'Taichi'ud', 'A'uchu-Ba'atur', 'Qotun-Orchang': match published parts; no change.
- titleEn vs part wording differ ('Pursuit'/'Flight'); refused, published 140–143 also differ.
- Suffix morphs without a Ming bracket (e.g. -u, -be): refused; published parts bracket only where the Ming marks the ending.
- oduluγ̇a (odu- + -luγ̇a) vs γaruluγ̇a (γar-ul-uγ̇a) decomposition: left; both defensible, glossary treats -luγ̇a as past.

## Remaining doubts

- Jelme's plan, units 49–55: whether tan 'you' is the enemy (drafter and I read so) or Chinggis; taluγ̇a; üdüġüj-e; aldaγ̇ulžu; 'asaraqu'; 'elüssügei'. Marked (?) in i where I had no ground.
- Unit 47 (ülü-ü žiγ̇aqu büleġe): reading 'would you not have told them of me like this' rests on Ming 我行 這般行 不吿麽 and is close in shape to what a modern translation would say; I could not rebuild it differently from the grammar. Flagged to the pass-2 reader.
- Unit 48 only a frame; unit 52 now 'I would say'; the quote structure of 49–54 (inner single quotes) is the drafter's choice, Shiratori marks none.
- nigente 'once' (vs 'at one go') and γurbanta 'three times': follow the glossary, uncertain.
- Unit 4 who 'their own' belongs to; unit 6 An-i accusative; unit 9 edeġed/hüleġüd; unit 12 boldažu; unit 25 who stands (baiqun); unit 65 čin-u sedkil dotora min-u.
- žasqaqu-ji: stray ž confirmed by the Han 阿思中合中忽 (a-); keep as misprint.
- 'ring camp' (küreġeležü) matches the published 'ring of tents' (küreġen).
- Glossary (`gloss.json`) not yet present; second pass must check lemma/gloss entries, esp. amin-(n)i-jan (now accusative), nigente, čima-.


# Review, pass 2 — secret-history-144-145 (§§144–145)

Checked: all 66 units again (grammar labels, l against i, remembered English, morph lemmas against the shared glossary and `known-forms.json`), the pass-1 changes (amin-(n)i-jan, nigente, čima-, the new morph splits), unit 47 rebuilt from the grammar, and every entry of `gloss.json` (dictionary form, meaning against each use, grammar label, Ming bracket against `novel-forms.json` — all 130 brackets match — fragments ni-jan, tu, lerün, ügü, težü, dotoγ̇aži, and the seven `__broaden__` entries). `t` untouched (434 words, all units identical to pass 1); edits by script, each an exact-once replacement or an asserted morph change.

Counts: major 0, moderate 9, minor 24, trivial 13 (total 46).

## Changes (unit/entry · field · severity · what was wrong · what was done)

- unit 47 · i · moderate · "told them of me like this": "them" is in no word; the sentence had been shaped by the expected sense. Rebuilt: "If you had been seized, would you not have told of me in this way?"
- unit 47 · n · moderate · Note repeated the same sense and "a prisoner would be made to speak" came from outside the text. Rewritten from the endings (passive conditional, no written subject, double -ji, ülü + -ü, participle + büleġe = "would have"); states that nothing says what was told or to whom; the sense rests on the Ming alone.
- unit 47 · words[büleġe].morph[1] · trivial · Added that participle + büleġe carries "would have".

## Findings refused

- `__broaden__` jen, jan, ne, qarin, bolun, ambar, žaγ̇ura: each is the old entry whole + ' · ' + the new reading, and each addition fits the use in this part (jen: geġüd(i)-, öġer(i)-; jan: ulus(i)-, ulus-tur(i)-, deġel-qubčasun(i)-; ne: küġün-(n)e agent; qarin: qari- + -n; bolun: "cease" for ülü bolun; ambar: "how"; žaγ̇ura: "meanwhile"). No change.
- qučiγ̇ulqui-dur (quči- + -γ̇ul-) against the glossary's qučiγ- + -ul-: the dotted spelling here fits -γ̇ul- as in oro-γ̇ul-ba; both house analyses exist. Left.
- ködölžüġüi (-žü + -ġüi "bui") against the glossary's -žuγ̇ui/-žuγ̇u "past": both readings are in the house glossary; the Ming 有 supports "is". Left, as in unit 10 (baižuγ̇ui).
- tal- (talžu) vs talu- (taluγ̇a): not merged; unit 51 is already marked uncertain. Cross-reference added only.
- undaγ̇a- + -su- (unit 23): "stem-extender (uncertain)" is already hedged; no better ground.
- ügü / lerün / tu / dotoγ̇aži fragments: sensible and in the style of the existing split-word entries (göre, daγ̇a); the empty bracket on lerün matches daγ̇a. Kept.
- boldažu against the glossary's bolda-: unit 12 stays bol- + -da- + -žu (pass 1 accepted); only the label was fixed.
- qadqu- (here) against qadqul- (shared glossary entry qadquldužu): the entries for qadqulduja and our novel forms agree on qadqu-; the shared entry is the odd one. Left.
- baγ̇u- (units) against baγu- (shared entry): dot notation only. Left.
- Unit 49 parenthetical "(to the enemy, in the speech I had in mind)" and unit 10 "in order of battle": explanatory but hedged in the notes; left.
- Unit 51 aldaγ̇ulžu (causative) rendered "slip away from them": pass 1 and the note flag it; left.

## Remaining doubts

- Unit 47: the reading "told of me" rests wholly on the Ming; no better one comes from the grammar.
- Unit 51 üdüġüj-e "before then (?)" and taluγ̇a; unit 55 elüssügei; unit 42 alžijaqui; unit 6 An-i.
- Ming bracket placement was checked only for the gloss entries and the units changed here (pass 1 checked the rest).
